data: Largest member of the L4 Eurybates Trojan family — a collisional cluster of 64-km parent and ~280 smaller fragments. Lucy's 2027-08-12 encounter at 5.7 km/s will be the first close-up of a Jupiter Trojan ever, accompanied by Eurybates's 1-km moon Queta (discovered by Hubble in 2018).

64-km C-type asteroid — the largest member of the L4 Trojan Eurybates family, a fragment cluster from a collisional breakup. Has a 1-km moon (Queta) discovered by Hubble in 2018. Lucy's first Trojan encounter, 2027-08-12 at 5.7 km/s.
Lucy — NASA, August 2027 flyby (first Trojan-asteroid encounter)
Eurybates orbits in the L4 Jupiter Trojan cloud — leading the planet by 60°. Lucy will be the first spacecraft to visit a Trojan (August 2027).
A planet that almost was — the rocky remnants between Mars and Jupiter that Jupiter's gravity wouldn't let coalesce.
